verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is a desktop AI agent, so a local command-execution and file-editing surface is a fair question for it. The evidence never documents a built-in skill that runs shell commands or edits local files. Custom Agent Skills (a developer guide) and MCP compatibility are only building blocks a developer could use to construct such a capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can run commands and edit files on my machine — a real exec surface, not just chat about what to do
